items.label: Sun
items.ask: I am a big hot star. I give light to all the planets.

items.label: Mercury
items.ask: I am the smallest planet, and the closest to the Sun.

items.label: Venus
items.ask: I am the hottest planet. I shine bright in the evening sky.

items.label: Earth
items.ask: I am blue and green. I am our home!

items.label: Moon
items.ask: I go around the Earth. You see me at night.

items.label: Mars
items.ask: I am red and dusty. People call me the red planet.

items.label: Jupiter
items.ask: I am the biggest planet. I have a big red spot.

items.label: Saturn
items.ask: I have big shiny rings around me.

items.label: Uranus
items.ask: I am a cold blue green planet. I spin on my side.

items.label: Neptune
items.ask: I am dark blue and very windy. I am the farthest planet from the Sun.

items.label: Umbrella
items.ask: I open up when it rains. I keep you dry. What am I?

items.label: Clock
items.ask: I have a face and two hands, but no arms or legs. I tell you the time. What am I?

items.label: Sun
items.ask: I am big, yellow and hot. I come up in the sky every morning. What am I?

items.label: Moon
items.ask: I come out at night. Sometimes I am round, sometimes I am thin. What am I?

items.label: Cow
items.ask: I say moo. I eat grass. I give you milk. Who am I?

items.label: Elephant
items.ask: I am very big and grey. I have a long trunk. Who am I?

items.label: Banana
items.ask: I am long and yellow. Monkeys love me. You peel me before you eat me. What am I?

items.label: Ice cream
items.ask: I am cold and sweet. I melt in the sun. What am I?

items.label: Fish
items.ask: I live in water. I have fins and a tail. I swim but I cannot walk. Who am I?

items.label: Rainbow
items.ask: I come after the rain. I have seven colours. I bend across the sky. What am I?

items.label: Egg
items.ask: I am white and oval. A little chick comes out of me. What am I?

items.label: Kite
items.ask: I fly high in the sky, but I have no wings. You hold my string. What am I?

items.label: Tree
items.ask: I am tall and green. Birds make nests in me. I give you shade. What am I?

items.label: Toothbrush
items.ask: I help you clean your teeth every morning and every night. What am I?

items.label: Pillow
items.ask: I am soft. You put your head on me when you sleep. What am I?

items.label: Shoes
items.ask: You wear us on your feet. We always come in a pair. What are we?

items.label: Bee
items.ask: I am small and I buzz. I make sweet honey. Who am I?

items.label: Spider
items.ask: I have eight legs. I make a sticky web. Who am I?

items.label: Mirror
items.ask: When you look at me, you see yourself. What am I?

items.label: Pencil
items.ask: I help you write and draw. I get shorter when you sharpen me. What am I?
